name: @life-editor/shared
_comment_sideEffects: Everything in shared/src only DECLARES things at import time (no bare `import "..."`, no CSS, no global registration) — the one exception is i18n/index.ts, which runs i18next.init() at module scope, so it is listed and stays exempt. Both the src and the dist path are listed: web/desktop alias onto ../shared/src today, but `main`/`exports` above point at ./dist, and a consumer resolving THROUGH the package would miss a src-only entry and get its i18n init tree-shaken away. Saying all this lets the bundler drop the parts of the root barrel an entry never uses; without it the whole graph rode along and Connect's d3 stack sat in the initial chunk even though only the lazy Connect chunk referenced it (#676 — that graph was retired in #1152 and its d3 packages dropped in #1220, so this is a worked example now rather than a live cost; the mechanism it describes is unchanged). Add an import-time effect anywhere else and you must list that file here too — shared/tests/analyticsTabsLightweight.test.ts pins this field so it cannot be dropped silently.

scripts._comment_typecheck: composite project: `typecheck` runs `tsc -b` which ALSO emits dist (build side effect). It is intentionally an alias of `build`, not a pure --noEmit check, because project references require emitted .d.ts. Do not 'fix' it to `tsc --noEmit`.
scripts._comment_typecheck_tests: tests/ are outside tsconfig.json's include (that project emits dist/ and must not ship the suites), so they are checked by their own config — see tsconfig.test.json. Blocking in CI, with a shrinking per-file baseline.
